correctness.rationale: The source incidence model is locally a constant-rank-three quadric d^2-4ce=0 with two free kernel coordinates, so it is Cohen--Macaulay and regular in codimension one; hence normal. Proper birationality is from the source, and quasi-finiteness follows because a pencil cannot contain a projective line of double-line points inside the Veronese surface. The marked-pair map resolves by the two explicit blow-up charts and identifies the exceptional locus with the kernel P^1-bundle.
